title: Centurion South Downs Way 100 2026 — ITRA race page
claims: ITRA dates the 2026 race to 13 June 2026 with a start time of 05:30 and lists it as a solo race.
ITRA gives the distance as 160.56 km, elevation gain of +3,393 m and loss of -3,487 m, a time limit of 30:00 hours, 14 aid stations and 500 participants.
ITRA classifies the race as Mountain Level 2 with a Finisher Level of 490 and includes it in the National League; the fetched page does not show a numeric ITRA point value.
The ITRA course page gives the start as Winchester and the finish as Eastbourne, with terrain of 85% paths, 10% tracks and 5% roads.
